row.title: A drift check that skips a class of workers measures nothing for them
row.body: deploydrift reported every Worker whose source lives in a tenant repository as external and never read it, so ultrastable-base-rates served 3 entries while its main held 7 (its /api/beats showed the same stub note for a day). A Worker bundles its data at deploy, so every commit its loop makes is stale until redeployed. Rule: every live Worker gets a reading, an exemption class reads unmeasured at worst, never clean or skipped; deploydrift now compares a tenant Worker's last recorded deploy with the newest commit on its source ref and the watchdog redeploys it.

title: A drift check that skips a class of workers measures nothing for them
